semantics.delete_local_definitions: local records whose canonical type now lives in cod2_canon.h/cod2_types.h; remove them (and their asserts) from chunk_NNN_types.h.
semantics.drop_extern_globals: symbols.json globals that the chunk header re-declares; delete those externs and include cod2_globals.h (types may differ from the chunk-local ones).
semantics.field_renames: "LocalType.oldField" -> canonical member path (relative to the canonical type). Paths may descend into embedded members (s.eType, r.currentOrigin, cs.team, netchan.qport) or index arrays (stats[0], viewSprings...). Computed by offset from clang record layouts of chunk_NNN_types.h; review every rename whose note says check every access.
semantics.notes: size mismatches (truncated local views), fields that fall into canonical padding, byte blobs spanning several canonical fields, and type-class mismatches.
semantics.replace_types: local tag/typedef -> canonical tag. If the target is defined in cod2_canon.h or cod2_types.h, delete the local definition and use the canonical type; otherwise the target is a subsystem-owned tag: rename the local definition (keep it in the owning chunk) so every chunk mangles the same name.
semantics.signatures: Rewrite each symbols.json function signature with the replace_types map of its owning chunk (functions[addr].chunk); tag names decide C++ mangling, so this is what removes most of the 1,199 signature mismatches.
